name: @mgread-plugin/mifun-video
description: MgRead native source for MiFun anime.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/contract.test.mjs test/source.test.mjs
scripts.pack:plugin: npm run build && node tools/mgread.mjs pack
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run pack:plugin

mgread.description: MiFun 是以动漫为主的视频网站，按分类整理动漫作品。可查看作品介绍和分集目录，搜索想看的动漫并选择集数观看。
